$comment: Configuration of scripts/generate.mjs: which groups (tags) of the portal's published specification go into each resource of the node, in which order, the English names of the categories, the English labels of the fields, the descriptions of the specification's fields that are replaced, and notes of what a domain's code requires and its specification does not say. Operations, their names and fields come from the specification (names and purposes in English from scripts/operations.en.json); here they are only grouped and labelled. A group no resource lists gets a resource of its own, so nothing the portal publishes is left out. A resource with optional: true may not be in the specification yet. When a new specification renames an operation, moves it to another group or changes the kind of a field the node already published, keepOperationValues, operationResources and keepFieldKinds keep what saved workflows use; defaultResource and each defaultOperation pin what a saved workflow that never changed them runs; fieldDefaults sets which option an option field shows first; extraParameters adds query fields a domain's code reads and its specification does not list; fieldDescriptionsByName gives fields their English description (a description of the specification in Spanish is not shown).

operationNotes.messageReaction.update: With an API key it answers 202 without a body: a reaction is not a message with an ID. If the provider does not support it, 422 with reason provider_unsupported.
operationNotes.messageReaction.destroy: With an API key it answers 202 without a body: a reaction is not a message with an ID. If the provider does not support it, 422 with reason provider_unsupported.
operationNotes.deviceProvisioning.store: Needs a key of the account owner (403 connect_not_allowed) and a place in the plan (403 numbers_not_included or number_limit_reached). While a QR number has never been connected, it answers 409 pending_number_exists with its device_id: connect it or delete it. A QR number is not official: WhatsApp may restrict it if it sends messages people do not expect.
operationNotes.deviceProvisioning.qr: WhatsApp changes the code every few seconds until it is scanned: ask again every expires_in seconds (5) and show only the last one. qr_code is a PNG as a data URI, or null while the session starts. An official number answers 422 provider_unsupported. In n8n a connect link is simpler: its page shows the QR and renews it on its own.
operationNotes.connectLink.store: The url appears only in this response, and whoever has it can connect a number to your account while the link is pending: treat it as a secret. With type qr the page shows the QR, and your customer has 10 minutes from tapping its button to scan it. While the official sign-up by link is not enabled, type meta answers 503 meta_connect_disabled. The result comes in device.connected (with connect_link_id and external_reference), in the return_url or with "Get a connect link". Up to 20 pending links per account.
operationNotes.connectLink.show: error_code says why it did not complete: link_expired, already_used, revoked, quota_exceeded, trial_number_blocked, facebook_auth_failed, meta_error, number_not_owned, qr_timeout or provider_error.
operationNotes.connectLink.destroy: Only a pending link: otherwise it answers 409 link_not_pending.
operationNotes.apiGroupAction.sendMessage: Asynchronous: it answers 202 with action_id and status queued. Read the outcome with "Get a group action" (result.message.uid is the message's ID in WhatsApp) or with the group_action.completed and group_action.failed events. With a QR number it goes out at the pace of low-speed scheduled messages; with an official number the 24-hour window and the number's quality are checked first. A group that is not in your account yet (one of the number's live list) is imported first, as Follow a group does: that also needs communities:operate (403 import_permission_required) and counts in its 5 per minute; if the number is not an admin of the group nothing is imported and it answers 422 device_not_group_admin.
operationNotes.apiGroupAction.show: An action of another account or workspace answers 404 action_not_found, like one that does not exist.
operationNotes.conversation.sendMessage: With an API key it answers 200 with the queued message (status queued) and its ID; the result comes later in the message.status_changed event. The WhatsApp guards apply: 24-hour window (422 window_closed), pace (429 rate_limited) and anti-blocking (422 antiblock_…). With an API key, Phone or WhatsApp ID is required and must be the contact's (otherwise 422 recipient_mismatch). If the account is in the 24-hour lockout for monthly active contacts, 429 mac_lockout_24h.
operationNotes.message.sendMessage: Say who receives it with Phone (with the country code): if it is not a contact of your account yet, it is created in your key's workspace (as Create or update a contact does, so the key needs conversations:write; without it, 403) and the message's contact_id comes in the answer. To a contact you already have, conversations:send is enough. A phone of a contact of another workspace answers 404. With Contact ID too, both have to be the same contact (422 recipient_mismatch). On an official number, the first message to a new contact has to be a template: a free message only goes out within 24 hours of the contact's last message. With an API key it answers 200 with the queued message (status queued) and its ID; the result comes later in the message.status_changed event. The WhatsApp guards apply: 24-hour window (422 window_closed), pace (429 rate_limited) and anti-blocking (422 antiblock_…); a contact created by the send stays even if a guard stops it.
operationNotes.forwardMessage.store: With an API key it answers 200 with one result per target: queued with its message, or blocked with the reason.
operationNotes.contactCard.store: With an API key it answers 200 with one queued message per card (status queued); the result comes later in the message.status_changed event. The WhatsApp guards apply: 24-hour window (422 window_closed), pace (429 rate_limited) and anti-blocking (422 antiblock_…).
operationNotes.messageTemplate.send: Say who receives it with Phone (with the country code), always, with or without Contact ID: if it is not a contact of your account yet, it is created in your key's workspace (the key needs conversations:write for that; without it, 403) and the message's contact_id comes in the answer. To a contact you already have, conversations:send is enough. A phone of a contact of another workspace answers 404; Phone and Contact ID have to be the same contact (422 recipient_mismatch). With an API key it answers 200 with the queued message (status queued) and its ID; the result comes in the message.status_changed event. A template does not need the 24-hour window.
operationNotes.whatsappFormSend.store: With an API key it answers 200 with the queued message (status queued) and its ID; the result comes later in the message.status_changed event. The WhatsApp guards apply: 24-hour window (422 window_closed), pace (429 rate_limited) and anti-blocking (422 antiblock_…). Its own errors: 404 form_not_found and 422 form_not_published, form_not_on_number, number_not_eligible.
operationNotes.webhookSubscription.index: With an API key, besides the route's permission, it needs the read permission of the area of each event type of the subscription (accounts:read, conversations:read or communities:read).
operationNotes.webhookSubscription.store: With an API key, besides the route's permission, it needs the read permission of the area of each event type of the subscription (accounts:read, conversations:read or communities:read).
operationNotes.webhookSubscription.show: With an API key, besides the route's permission, it needs the read permission of the area of each event type of the subscription (accounts:read, conversations:read or communities:read).
operationNotes.webhookSubscription.update: With an API key, besides the route's permission, it needs the read permission of the area of each event type of the subscription (accounts:read, conversations:read or communities:read).
operationNotes.webhookSubscription.destroy: Irreversible operation. With an API key, besides the route's permission, it needs the read permission of the area of each event type of the subscription (accounts:read, conversations:read or communities:read).
operationNotes.webhookSubscriptionDelivery.index: With an API key, besides the route's permission, it needs the read permission of the area of each event type of the subscription (accounts:read, conversations:read or communities:read).
operationNotes.webhookSubscriptionTest.test: With an API key, besides the route's permission, it needs the read permission of the area of each event type of the subscription (accounts:read, conversations:read or communities:read).
operationNotes.apiGroupAction.create: Asynchronous: it answers 202 with an action_id; read the outcome with "Get a group action" or the group_action.completed and group_action.failed events. The result brings the group and its invite link. join_approval_required only on an official number (a QR number answers 422 provider_unsupported), and it cannot be changed later.
operationNotes.apiGroupAction.addParticipants: Asynchronous: it answers 202 with an action_id; read the outcome with "Get a group action" or the group_action.completed and group_action.failed events. With a QR number each phone is added one after the other, at the pace of campaigns. The result says added or failed for each person.
operationNotes.apiGroupAction.removeParticipants: Asynchronous: it answers 202 with an action_id; read the outcome with "Get a group action" or the group_action.completed and group_action.failed events. The phone of the number that runs it cannot be removed.
operationNotes.apiGroupAction.promoteAdmins: Asynchronous: it answers 202 with an action_id; read the outcome with "Get a group action" or the group_action.completed and group_action.failed events. It runs at the pace of the number's campaigns.
operationNotes.apiGroupAction.demoteAdmins: Asynchronous: it answers 202 with an action_id; read the outcome with "Get a group action" or the group_action.completed and group_action.failed events. The phone of the number that runs it is not accepted. It runs at the pace of the number's campaigns.
operationNotes.apiGroupAction.updateName: Asynchronous: it answers 202 with an action_id; read the outcome with "Get a group action" or the group_action.completed and group_action.failed events. It runs at the pace of the number's campaigns.
operationNotes.apiGroupAction.updateDescription: Asynchronous: it answers 202 with an action_id; read the outcome with "Get a group action" or the group_action.completed and group_action.failed events. It runs at the pace of the number's campaigns.
operationNotes.apiGroupAction.updatePhoto: Asynchronous: it answers 202 with an action_id; read the outcome with "Get a group action" or the group_action.completed and group_action.failed events. It runs at the pace of the number's campaigns.
operationNotes.apiGroupAction.updateSettings: Asynchronous: it answers 202 with an action_id; read the outcome with "Get a group action" or the group_action.completed and group_action.failed events. It runs at the pace of the number's campaigns.
operationNotes.apiGroupAction.renewInviteLink: Asynchronous: it answers 202 with an action_id; read the outcome with "Get a group action" or the group_action.completed and group_action.failed events. The result brings invite_link.
operationNotes.apiGroupAction.joinRequests: Official numbers with the official API groups beta only: a QR number answers 422 provider_unsupported. Requests without a phone are left out. Up to 30 requests per minute.
operationNotes.apiGroupAction.approveJoinRequests: Asynchronous: it answers 202 with an action_id; read the outcome with "Get a group action" or the group_action.completed and group_action.failed events. Official numbers with the official API groups beta and decisions enabled only; otherwise 422 provider_unsupported. The result is per person.
operationNotes.apiGroupAction.rejectJoinRequests: Asynchronous: it answers 202 with an action_id; read the outcome with "Get a group action" or the group_action.completed and group_action.failed events. Official numbers with the official API groups beta and decisions enabled only; otherwise 422 provider_unsupported. The result is per person.
operationNotes.v2.apiGroupImport: QR numbers only (an official number answers 422 provider_unsupported). It answers 201 when it imports the group and 200 when it was already in the account, with is_admin, read from WhatsApp in the same call. Needs communities:operate (403 import_permission_required). Up to 5 per number per minute (429 import_rate_limited, with Retry-After); a group of another number answers 404 group_not_found, one in another workspace of the account cannot be imported here. From then on the group sends the group_participant.joined and group_participant.left events.
operationNotes.group.groups: Read live from WhatsApp; with an API key the list is reused for one minute per number, so a group just created may take up to a minute to show. A group already in your account comes with its device_id; to follow one that is not, use Follow a group.
operationNotes.messageTemplate.sync: It answers 202 with status: completed when it is done, and in_progress when the first page (up to 100 templates) is in and the rest keeps coming in the background; then list again (List templates) in a few seconds. It also removes the templates of a WhatsApp Business account the number no longer uses. One at a time per number: 409 template_sync_in_progress while one is running. 422 number_not_connected_to_meta if the number is connected by QR or has no WhatsApp Business account or credentials in Meta; 422 meta_rejected (with Meta's meta_code) if Meta refused and nothing was brought; 502 meta_unavailable if Meta did not answer.

alertDestination.update.name: The destination's name; null clears it.
alertDestination.update.destination: Only for a webhook: the new URL, https and resolving to a public internet address.

apiGroupAction.sendMessage.group: The group's uid: one of your groups (List groups) or of the number's live list (List the groups a number manages), which is imported first.
apiGroupAction.sendMessage.device_id: The number that sends: connected, and an admin of the group (a QR number) or the group's own number (an official one).
apiGroupAction.sendMessage.text: Only with type text, and required there.
apiGroupAction.sendMessage.media_url: Only with image, video, audio or document, and required there: a public https URL that ends in an extension WhatsApp accepts for the type.
apiGroupAction.sendMessage.caption: Only with image or video.
apiGroupAction.sendMessage.file_name: Only with document: the name it arrives with.

connectLink.index.external_reference: Only the links with exactly this reference.

connectLink.store.type: qr: a number connected by scanning a QR code. meta: an official number, with Meta's Embedded Signup.
connectLink.store.allowed_connection_types: Only with type meta, and required there: coexistence keeps the number in the WhatsApp Business app; dedicated is a number only for the API.
connectLink.store.provision_us_number: Only with type meta: also offer a US number of Funnelchat's pool (always dedicated).
connectLink.store.device_id: Reconnect this number of the account instead of adding one (it takes no new place).
connectLink.store.same_number_as: Only with type qr: add QR to this number of the account in coexistence.
connectLink.store.country: Only with type qr and without Number ID: country the WhatsApp session is opened from, two letters (the country of your customer's phone).
connectLink.store.external_reference: Your own reference: it is copied to the number the link creates and comes in device.connected.
connectLink.store.return_url: https address the page sends your customer to at the end, with the result in the query string (connect_link_id, status, and device_id or error_code).
connectLink.store.expires_in_minutes: How long the link lives: 30 to 10080 minutes (7 days); 1440 (24 hours) by default.

contact.store.custom_fields: Optional. Values of custom fields for the contact, up to 100 items {id, value}: id is the ID of a field of your account (List custom fields) and value is its value, always text, in the format of the field's type. If an id is not of your account or workspace, or a value does not fit its type, it answers 422 and creates or changes nothing.

contact.updateOrCreate.custom_fields: Optional. Values of custom fields for the contact, up to 100 items {id, value}: id is the ID of a field of your account (List custom fields) and value is its value, always text, in the format of the field's type. If an id is not of your account or workspace, or a value does not fit its type, it answers 422 and creates or changes nothing.

contactCard.store.client_reference: Your own identifier for this send (1 to 64 visible ASCII characters, no spaces). It comes back in the message and in the message.status_changed event, to match them with your system.

conversation.sendMessage.file: http(s) URL of the file (also signed or without an extension, with File Type) or the name of an already uploaded file.
conversation.sendMessage.file_type: What the file is, when File is a URL that does not show its extension (for example a signed URL). Without it, such a URL answers 422 on file_type.
conversation.sendMessage.file_name: Name the document arrives with (without / \ ? #). Needed for a document whose URL does not end in a known extension.
conversation.sendMessage.client_reference: Your own identifier for this send (1 to 64 visible ASCII characters, no spaces). It comes back in the message and in the message.status_changed event, to match them with your system.

customDomain.switchValidationMethod.method: How the domain's certificate is validated. HTTP (the default): it is issued when the domain's DNS record already points, without a TXT record. TXT: validated with a TXT record, for a domain that cannot point yet.

customField.index.type: Only the fields of this type: 0 text, 1 number, 2 date, 3 URL, 4 alphanumeric.

customField.store.type: The field's type, chosen when it is created and not changed later. It says how its value is written (always as text): 0 text, any text; 1 number, with a dot for decimals and no thousands separator ("1500", "99.90"); 2 date, YYYY-MM-DD; 3 URL, with https:// or http://; 4 alphanumeric, any text. A value with another format answers 422 and is not saved.

device.index.external_reference: Only the numbers with exactly this reference: yours, given when creating the number or the connect link.

device.update.capi_consent: Consent to Meta's Conversions API (CAPI). Optional; it only applies to WhatsApp Cloud numbers of accounts with Conversions API enabled.
device.update.external_reference: Your own reference for this number (for example, your customer's ID); null clears it. Not unique.

deviceProvisioning.store.connection: How the number connects. Only qr: an official number is connected with a connect link of type meta.
deviceProvisioning.store.external_reference: Your own reference for this number (for example, your customer's ID). Not unique. It comes back in the number and in the device.* events.
deviceProvisioning.store.same_number_as: ID of a number of the account connected to the official API in coexistence: the QR connection is added to that same number and takes no new place in the plan.
deviceProvisioning.store.country: Country the WhatsApp session is opened from, two letters (for example mx): the country of the phone that will scan the QR. Without it, co (Colombia).

forwardMessage.store.client_reference: Your own identifier for this send (1 to 64 visible ASCII characters, no spaces). It comes back in the message and in the message.status_changed event, to match them with your system.

groupMetadata.show.groupUid: The ID of the group or the channel on WhatsApp.

message.sendMessage.file: http(s) URL of the file (also signed or without an extension, with File Type) or the name of an already uploaded file.
message.sendMessage.file_type: What the file is, when File is a URL that does not show its extension (for example a signed URL). Without it, such a URL answers 422 on file_type.
message.sendMessage.file_name: Name the document arrives with (without / \ ? #). Needed for a document whose URL does not end in a known extension.
message.sendMessage.client_reference: Your own identifier for this send (1 to 64 visible ASCII characters, no spaces). It comes back in the message and in the message.status_changed event, to match them with your system.
message.sendMessage.phone: The recipient's phone with the country code, for example 5491122334455. No need to create the contact first: a new phone becomes a contact, which takes conversations:write.
message.sendMessage.whatsapp_id: Instead of Phone, on an official number only: the BSUID Meta sends (for example US.13491208655302741918). With a QR number it answers 422.
message.sendMessage.contact_id: Optional: a contact you already have. With Phone or WhatsApp ID too, they have to be of this same contact.

messageTemplate.send.client_reference: Your own identifier for this send (1 to 64 visible ASCII characters, no spaces). It comes back in the message and in the message.status_changed event, to match them with your system.
messageTemplate.send.phone: The recipient's phone with the country code, for example 5491122334455. No need to create the contact first: a new phone becomes a contact, which takes conversations:write. It goes always, with or without Contact ID.
messageTemplate.send.whatsapp_id: Instead of Phone, on an official number only: the BSUID Meta sends (for example US.13491208655302741918). With a QR number it answers 422.
messageTemplate.send.contact_id: Optional: a contact you already have. With Phone or WhatsApp ID too, they have to be of this same contact.

messageTemplate.sync.device: The ID of the official number whose templates are brought.

scheduledMessage.groupMessages.edit_status: Only the groups with this result of the last edit of the text already sent (not the delivery status): 1 edited in time; 2 delivered, but 15 minutes had passed since it went to that group; 3 sent with an official number, to a channel or with a number that cannot edit; 4 WhatsApp answered an error, or the message never reached the group.
scheduledMessage.groupMessages.run: Date (YYYY-MM-DD, in the account's time zone) of one run of the send: the result of each group in that run. Without it, the last result of each group.

scheduledMessage.index.only_needs_connection: With true, only the pending or running sends that have groups without a connected number that can send. Takes true, false, 1 or 0.

v2.apiGroupImport.group: The group's ID on WhatsApp, as List the groups a number manages returns it.
v2.apiGroupImport.device_id: The QR number the group belongs to.

webhookEndpoint.store.url: Must be https and resolve to a public internet address.
webhookEndpoint.store.events: Initial subscriptions, optional: without events the endpoint is registered without receiving anything, and subscribes later.

webhookSubscription.store.url: Public `https` URL that receives the deliveries. Without user or password; an internal address is rejected.
webhookSubscription.store.events: Event types of the catalog (`GET /api/v1/webhooks/events`) that can be subscribed to. With an API key, each type needs the read permission of its area.
webhookSubscription.store.description: Text to recognize the subscription in the list.
webhookSubscription.store.filters: Optional filter by campaigns (`campaign_ids`): with a filter, an event without a campaign is not delivered.

webhookSubscription.update.url: Public `https` URL that receives the deliveries.
webhookSubscription.update.events: The full list of event types: it replaces the previous one.
webhookSubscription.update.description: Text to recognize the subscription in the list.
webhookSubscription.update.status: Pause or resume the subscription. It cannot be set to `disabled`.

whatsappFormSend.store.client_reference: Your own identifier for this send (1 to 64 visible ASCII characters, no spaces). It comes back in the message and in the message.status_changed event, to match them with your system.
